SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976 AND "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "card_disp" ON "card_disp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "card_disp".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "card_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "card_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "aa".avg_balance > 1000 AND CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) > 100000), "district_stats" AS (SELECT gender, district_id, inhabitants, salary, urban_ratio, MAX(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS "max_inhabitants", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS "district_count", AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS "avg_salary", AVG(urban_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS "avg_urban_ratio" FROM "eligible") SELECT CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'Women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Men' END AS "gender", district_count, district_id, inhabitants, ROUND(avg_salary::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(avg_urban_ratio::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_inhabitant_ratio" FROM "district_stats" WHERE inhabitants = max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, district_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'gold' AND "di".a4::INTEGER >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account) SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount FROM "pair_totals" ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 ILIKE '%Pisek%' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "dp".type = 'OWNER'), "region_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "qd".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".a2 ASC) AS "rn" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "qd".district_id) SELECT "rs".region, "rs".average_district_salary, "rs".average_1996_unemployment_rate, "rd".district_name AS "most_populous_district" FROM "region_stats" AS "rs" INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".region = "rs".region AND "rd".rn = 1 LIMIT 501

WITH "district_crimes" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3, "d".a16 AS "inhabitants", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "crime_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a16), "top_three" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, inhabitants, crime_count FROM "district_crimes" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 3) SELECT district_name, crime_count, ROUND(AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) OVER (), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) FROM "district_crimes"), 2) AS "country_average", ROUND(AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) OVER () - (SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) FROM "district_crimes"), 2) AS "difference" FROM "top_three" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "markets" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca".type AS "card_type", "cl".district_id, "d".a2 AS "home_district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id), "minima" AS (SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants) AS "inhabitants" FROM "markets" GROUP BY card_type) SELECT "m".card_type, "m".home_district, "m".inhabitants FROM "markets" AS "m" INNER JOIN "minima" AS "x" ON "x".card_type = "m".card_type AND "x".inhabitants = "m".inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "m".card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, "m".home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "a"."account_id", "d"."a2" AS "district_name" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "a"."district_id" WHERE "a"."date" >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a"."date" < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d"."a3" = 'north Bohemia'), "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t"."account_id") "t"."account_id", "t"."balance" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e"."account_id" = "t"."account_id" WHERE "t"."date" < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t"."account_id" ASC, "t"."date" DESC, "t"."trans_id" DESC), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "e"."account_id", "e".district_name, "l"."balance" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "latest" AS "l" ON "l"."account_id" = "e"."account_id") SELECT ROUND(AVG("balance")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "region_average_balance" FROM "account_balances" LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "ranked_loans" AS "rl" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "rl".account_id WHERE "rl".rn <= 10), "inhabitants_leader" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "top_districts" AS "td" ON "td".district_id = "d".district_id ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "il".district_id, "il".inhabitants, ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_yearly_salary" FROM "inhabitants_leader" AS "il" INNER JOIN "top_districts" AS "td" ON TRUE INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "td".district_id GROUP BY "il".district_id, "il".inhabitants LIMIT 501

WITH "withdrawals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "order_debits" AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "debit" FROM "order" WHERE k_symbol IN ('SIPO', 'UVER') GROUP BY account_id), "metrics" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, "w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "per_inhabitant", COALESCE(SUM("o".debit), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT("a".account_id) AS "avg_debit" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "withdrawals" AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "order_debits" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4, "w".total_withdrawn) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(avg_debit, 2) AS "avg_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "metrics" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "client_info" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "client" AS "c" WHERE "c".client_id = 3541), "accessible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client_info" AS "ci" ON "ci".client_id = "d".client_id), "transaction_stats" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "region_districts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a11 DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a11 DESC) AS "most_populous_district", FIRST_VALUE("d".a11) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a11 DESC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d"), "clients_per_region" AS (SELECT "hd".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "hd".a3) SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened_date", "a".frequency, "ad".a2 AS "district_name", "ad".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "ad".district_id = "ci".home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "ad".a12 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "cpr".client_count AS "clients_in_region", "rd".most_populous_district, "rd".most_populous_inhabitants, "rd".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "accessible" AS "ac" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ac".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id CROSS JOIN "client_info" AS "ci" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_stats" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "region_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".region = "ad".a3 AND "rd".district_name = "ad".a2 AND "rd".inhabitants = "ad".a11 INNER JOIN "clients_per_region" AS "cpr" ON "cpr".region = "ad".a3 ORDER BY COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "lent_amount" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::TEXT AS "opening_year", district_id, SUM(lent_amount)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), district_id) SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::TEXT AS "opening_year", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".lent_amount) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG("dy".lent_per_account), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district_year" AS "dy" ON "dy".opening_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::TEXT AND "dy".district_id = "al".district_id GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date) ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, "d".a2 AS "district", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT * FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE rn <= 10) SELECT "t".district, "t".amount AS "approved_amount", "t".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "t".account_id AND "tr".date <= "t".date ORDER BY "tr".date DESC, "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "end_of_day_balance" FROM "top_loans" AS "t" ORDER BY "t".amount DESC, "t".date ASC, "t".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date)::INT AS "age_at_card_issue", COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COUNT("l".loan_id) > 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COUNT("l".loan_id) > 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".card_id, "ca".type, "ca".issued, "dp".account_id, "d".a2, "d".a11 ORDER BY "c".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".account_id, "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".account_id) FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "k_symbol" = 'UROK' THEN "amount" WHEN "k_symbol" = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" WHERE "account_id" = (SELECT "account_id" FROM "disp" WHERE "client_id" = 2823 LIMIT 1) AND "date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "k_symbol" IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "female_loans" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "l".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT * FROM "female_loans" WHERE amount >= (SELECT amount FROM "female_loans" ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2)), "account_metrics" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'PRIJEM' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "top_loans" AS "tl" ON "tl".account_id = "t".account_id GROUP BY "t".account_id), "regional_metrics" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ld" ON "ld".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "ld".a3 = "d".a3) AS "loans_in_region", (SELECT AVG("d2".a11) FROM "district" AS "d2" WHERE "d2".a3 = "d".a3) AS "avg_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" GROUP BY "d".a3) SELECT "tl".client_id, "tl".amount, "tl".duration AS "duration_in_months", ROUND(("tl".payments * "tl".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("tl".payments * "tl".duration - "tl".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "tl".status AS "loan_status", "tl".district, "tl".region, COALESCE("am".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("am".total_deposits, 0) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("am".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "tl".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("am".total_deposits, 0) > "tl".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rm".loans_in_region, ROUND("rm".avg_salary::NUMERIC, 2) AS "region_average_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "tl".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age" FROM "top_loans" AS "tl" LEFT JOIN "account_metrics" AS "am" ON "am".account_id = "tl".account_id INNER JOIN "regional_metrics" AS "rm" ON "rm".region = "tl".region ORDER BY "tl".amount DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a16 AS "population" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a16 ORDER BY "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "monthly_accounts_opened", COUNT(DISTINCT "d".district_id) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_amount_received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_counts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "account_metrics" AS (SELECT "ga".account_id, "district".a2 AS "district_name", "district".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ga".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "ga".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_counts" AS "lc" ON "lc".account_id = "ga".account_id) SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_amount_received, total_amount_withdrawn, number_of_loans, external_counterparties, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account_metrics" ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date <= DATE '1996-12-31'), "owner_info" AS (SELECT "ea".account_id, "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age_years" FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "ea".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id), "card_counts" AS (SELECT "dp".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "card_count" FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "ea".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "dp".account_id), "loan_stats" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status = 'B') THEN 'defaulted' WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status IN ('C', 'D')) THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "standing" FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "ea".account_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "l".account_id), "activity" AS (SELECT "ea".account_id, COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER')), 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE(MAX("t".balance), 0) AS "peak_balance" FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "ea".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "ea".account_id), "profiles" AS (SELECT "ea".account_id, "ea".opened_date, "oi".gender, "oi".age_years, COALESCE("cc".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("ls".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("ls".standing, 'no loan') AS "loan_standing", "ac".transaction_count, "ac".money_in, "ac".money_out, "ac".peak_balance FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" INNER JOIN "owner_info" AS "oi" ON "oi".account_id = "ea".account_id LEFT JOIN "card_counts" AS "cc" ON "cc".account_id = "ea".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_stats" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "ea".account_id INNER JOIN "activity" AS "ac" ON "ac".account_id = "ea".account_id) SELECT account_id, opened_date, gender, age_years, card_count, loan_count, loan_standing, transaction_count, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "profiles" ORDER BY peak_balance_rank ASC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_clients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".client_id, "d".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'classic'), "client_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS "client_count" FROM "qualifying_clients" GROUP BY district_id), "external_payments" AS (SELECT "qc".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "external_account_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "qualifying_clients" AS "qc" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "qc".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "qc".district_id) SELECT "district".a2 AS "district_name", COALESCE("client_counts".client_count, 0) AS "client_count", COALESCE("external_payments".external_account_count, 0) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE("external_payments".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount" FROM "district" LEFT JOIN "client_counts" ON "client_counts".district_id = "district".district_id LEFT JOIN "external_payments" ON "external_payments".district_id = "district".district_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "acc".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "acc" ON "acc".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01') AS "client_account_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "client_account_districts".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary_czk" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "female_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "female_districts".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C' LIMIT 501

WITH "cohort_districts" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort' ELSE 'old cohort' END AS "cohort", "d".a11 AS "salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31') SELECT cohort, ROUND(AVG(salary)) AS "average_salary" FROM "cohort_districts" GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY CASE cohort WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((("r853".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC - "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) / "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "results" AS "r853" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r854" ON "r854".driverid = "r853".driverid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r853".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r853".raceid = 853 AND "r854".raceid = 854 AND "r853".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r854".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".positionorder <> 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "ra".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

WITH "wins" AS (SELECT "r".driverid, COUNT(*) AS "wins" FROM "results" AS "r" WHERE "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "r".driverid), "top_driver" AS (SELECT driverid FROM "wins" ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_recorded_driver_standings_points" FROM "top_driver" AS "td" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "td".driverid INNER JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "d".driverid GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds) * 100.0 / "last_finisher".milliseconds, 2) AS "percentage_shorter" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "winner".position = 1 AND "last_finisher".laps = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM "results" WHERE raceid = "r".raceid) AND "last_finisher".position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM "results" WHERE raceid = "r".raceid AND position IS NOT NULL AND laps = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM "results" WHERE raceid = "r".raceid)) AND "winner".milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND "last_finisher".milliseconds IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".laps = "w".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "d" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "dr" ON "dr".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "d".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "w" ON "w".raceid = "d".raceid AND "w".position = 1 WHERE "dr".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 AND "d".laps IS NOT NULL AND "w".laps IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "races".year, ROUND(AVG("results".milliseconds::NUMERIC) / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds" FROM "results" INNER JOIN "races" ON "results".raceid = "races".raceid WHERE "races".year < 1975 AND "results".position = 1 AND "results".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "races".year ORDER BY "races".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("res".points) AS "score", "c".name, "c".nationality FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "ci" ON "r".circuitid = "ci".circuitid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "res".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "r".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2008 AND "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "l".driverid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname ORDER BY MIN("l".milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "c".name, (MIN("l".milliseconds) / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN (MIN("l".milliseconds) / 1000) % 60 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ((MIN("l".milliseconds) / 1000) % 60)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN MIN("l".milliseconds) % 1000 < 100 THEN CASE WHEN MIN("l".milliseconds) % 1000 < 10 THEN '00' ELSE '0' END ELSE '' END || (MIN("l".milliseconds) % 1000)::TEXT AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "circuits" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "c".country = 'Italy' GROUP BY "c".circuitid, "c".name ORDER BY "c".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(stop_count), 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".stop) AS "stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name NOT IN (SELECT "r2000".name FROM "races" AS "r2000" WHERE "r2000".year = 2000) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_stop_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob, COUNT("q".qualifyid) FILTER (WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '') AS "q3_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'German' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1971-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1986-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob ORDER BY q3_times DESC, "d".dob ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "race" AS (SELECT "r".raceid FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'), "slowest" AS (SELECT "q".driverid, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q".q1) <> '' ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "s".q1 FROM "slowest" AS "s" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "s".driverid LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 1995 AND "ra".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q1 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MIN(BTRIM("q2".q1)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q1) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q2".driverid) FROM "qualifying" AS "q1" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q2" ON "q1".raceid = "q2".raceid AND "q2".position > "q1".position INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d1" ON "d1".driverid = "q1".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q1".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2010 AND "d1".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d1".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "q1".position IS NOT NULL AND "q2".position IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "q".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 2017 AND "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2row" WHERE "q2row".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2row".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q2row".q2 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) AS "runners_up_count" FROM "races" AS "ra" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "r".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) >= 2 ORDER BY runners_up_count DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, TO_CHAR(TIME '13:00:00' + ("res".milliseconds * INTERVAL '1 millisecond'), 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "local_finish_time", "d".url FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' ORDER BY "res".positionorder ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND ("q".q3 IS NULL OR BTRIM("q".q3) = '') LIMIT 501

WITH "q2_times" AS (SELECT "q".q2, "d".nationality, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER * 1000 + SPLIT_PART("q".q2, '.', 2)::INTEGER ASC) AS "time_rank" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '') SELECT DISTINCT nationality FROM "q2_times" WHERE time_rank = 2 ORDER BY nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND "q".q2 < '1:40.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".duration FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM "pitstops") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_lap_times::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times" FROM (SELECT "d".driverid, COUNT("q".q3) AS "q3_lap_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid) AS "per_driver" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "d".code IS NULL AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) > 120 AND "d".forename IN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, SUM("res".points) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM "laptimes") AS "lt" ON "lt".driverid = "res".driverid AND "lt".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

WITH "french_editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".date FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".year >= 1990 AND "c".country = 'France' AND "r".name ILIKE '%French Grand Prix%'), "fastest" AS (SELECT "l".raceid, "l".driverid, MIN("l".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" INNER JOIN "french_editions" AS "f" ON "f".raceid = "l".raceid GROUP BY "l".raceid, "l".driverid) SELECT "f".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, TO_CHAR(("x".fastest_ms / 60000)::INT, 'FM0') || ':' || TO_CHAR((("x".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000)::INT, 'FM00') || '.' || TO_CHAR("x".fastest_ms % 1000, 'FM000') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "french_editions" AS "f" LEFT JOIN "fastest" AS "x" ON "x".raceid = "f".raceid AND "x".fastest_ms > 90000 LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "x".driverid ORDER BY "f".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "q2".driverid = "d2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "d".driverid, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "q".q3, "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year, MIN("q".q3::INTERVAL) OVER () AS "fastest_q3" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob > DATE '1980-12-31' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '') SELECT driver_name AS "Driver full name", race_name AS "Race name", year AS "Race year", q3 AS "Q3 time" FROM "eligible" WHERE q3::INTERVAL = fastest_q3 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ranked".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM (SELECT "f".raceid, "f".driverid, "f".fastest_lap_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "f".raceid ORDER BY "f".fastest_lap_ms ASC) AS "lap_rank" FROM (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_lap_ms" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid) AS "f") AS "ranked" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ranked".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' AND "ranked".lap_rank = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "season_totals" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".raceid DESC) AS "rn" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid), "career" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("st".points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "season_totals" AS "st" ON "st".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "st".rn = 1 WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY CASE "d".forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 WHEN 'John' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".constructorid) FILTER (WHERE "r".fastestlap IS NOT NULL AND "r".rank = 1) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_races" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "ds".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19 AND "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013) SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".stop) AS "pit_stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "eligible_races" AS "er" ON "er".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC * 1000 > 120000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "p".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "p2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p2".milliseconds IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

WITH "winning_drivers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "chosen_driver" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality, dob FROM "winning_drivers" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "ra".name AS "race_name", "ra".date AS "race_date" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "chosen_driver" AS "cd" ON "cd".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "ra".date ASC, "ra".name ASC LIMIT 1), "career_starts" AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "total_starts" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "chosen_driver" AS "cd" ON "cd".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) SELECT "cd".forename || ' ' || "cd".surname AS "full_name", "cd".nationality, "fw".race_name, "fw".race_date, "cs".total_starts FROM "chosen_driver" AS "cd" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" CROSS JOIN "career_starts" AS "cs" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings_with_accident_retirement" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

WITH "q2_times" AS (SELECT "q".driverid, "q".constructorid, "q".q2, "r".grid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + split_part(split_part("q".q2, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER * 1000 + split_part("q".q2, '.', 2)::INTEGER DESC, "r".grid ASC) AS "rn" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid AND "r".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 2017 AND "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q".q2) <> '') SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name FROM "q2_times" AS "qt" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "qt".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "qt".constructorid WHERE "qt".rn = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" INNER JOIN "races" ON "qualifying".raceid = "races".raceid WHERE "races".year = 2017 AND "qualifying".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "qualifying".q2 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "chinese_editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".year, "r".time FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL), "earliest" AS (SELECT raceid, year, time FROM "chinese_editions" ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1), "finishers" AS (SELECT "e".raceid, "e".year, MAX(CASE WHEN "res".position = 1 THEN "res".milliseconds END) AS "winner_ms", MAX(CASE WHEN "res".position = 2 THEN "res".milliseconds END) AS "runner_up_ms" FROM "earliest" AS "e" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "e".raceid GROUP BY "e".raceid, "e".year) SELECT year, runner_up_ms - winner_ms AS "runner_up_time_gap_ms" FROM "finishers" WHERE winner_ms IS NOT NULL AND runner_up_ms IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "d".code IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("d".code) <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) < 98.000 LIMIT 501

SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MIN(time::TIME) FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL) THEN "c".circuitref END, ', ' ORDER BY CASE WHEN "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MIN(time::TIME) FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL) THEN "c".circuitref END ASC) AS "earliest_circuit_refs", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MAX(time::TIME) FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL) THEN "c".circuitref END, ', ' ORDER BY CASE WHEN "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MAX(time::TIME) FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL) THEN "c".circuitref END ASC) AS "latest_circuit_refs", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT MAX(time::TIME) FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL) - (SELECT MIN(time::TIME) FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL))) AS "gap_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND btrim("r".fastestlapspeed) <> '' ORDER BY "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q".q1) <> '' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR btrim("q".q2) = '') ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) AS "withdrew_drivers" FROM "races" AS "ra" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "st" ON "st".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "st".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status LIKE '%Lap%') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "r".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("ex".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "ex" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "ex".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "ex".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "ex".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END) AS "total_spent_difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending", SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget_amount" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "ratios" AS (SELECT event_id, event_name, total_spending::NUMERIC / NULLIF(total_budget_amount, 0) AS "spending_ratio" FROM "event_totals") SELECT event_name FROM "ratios" WHERE spending_ratio = (SELECT MAX(spending_ratio) FROM "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "name" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT COUNT("a".link_to_member) FROM "attendance" AS "a" WHERE "a".link_to_event = 'rec2N69DMcrqN9PJC') AS "womens_soccer_attendees", (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "event_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < DATE '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_counts") AS "fall_2019_average_attendees", CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT("a".link_to_member) FROM "attendance" AS "a" WHERE "a".link_to_event = 'rec2N69DMcrqN9PJC') > (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "event_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < DATE '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_counts") THEN 'more' WHEN (SELECT COUNT("a".link_to_member) FROM "attendance" AS "a" WHERE "a".link_to_event = 'rec2N69DMcrqN9PJC') < (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "event_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < DATE '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_counts") THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" LIMIT 501

WITH "dept_majors" AS (SELECT "m".department, "m".major_id, "m".major_name FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "counts" AS (SELECT "dm".department, "dm".major_id, "dm".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "mem".member_id) AS "member_count" FROM "dept_majors" AS "dm" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "dm".major_id GROUP BY "dm".department, "dm".major_id, "dm".major_name) SELECT department, STRING_AGG(major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", COALESCE(STRING_AGG(major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE member_count > 0), '') AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(AVG(member_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "counts" GROUP BY department ORDER BY department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended", COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b" WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT "e2".event_id FROM "event" AS "e2" WHERE "e2".type = "e".type AND "e2".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e2".event_date < '2020-01-01')), 0) AS "total_budgeted_dollars" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "ma" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' AND "m".member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM "attendance") LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "ma".college = 'College of Engineering' GROUP BY "ma".department ORDER BY "ma".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "e".link_to_member, "e".link_to_budget FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".cost > 50) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "qualifying".link_to_budget GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".type = 'Game' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college = (SELECT "mt".college FROM "member" AS "mem" INNER JOIN "major" AS "mt" ON "mt".major_id = "mem".link_to_major WHERE "mem".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "mem".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "mem2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "mm2" ON "mm2".major_id = "mem2".link_to_major WHERE "mm2".major_name = "m".major_name AND "mm2".college = "m".college) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS "average_members_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category ILIKE 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "major_counts" AS (SELECT "ma".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "ma".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma".major_name), "ranked" AS (SELECT major_name, attendee_count, MAX(attendee_count) OVER () AS "max_count" FROM "major_counts") SELECT major_name, attendee_count FROM "ranked" WHERE attendee_count = max_count ORDER BY major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".link_to_major IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "ma" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_major FROM "member" WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id LIMIT 501

SELECT member_group, ROUND(AVG(member_event_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'Officers' ELSE 'Other students' END AS "member_group", "m".member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "member_event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_counts" GROUP BY member_group ORDER BY CASE WHEN member_group = 'Officers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item_kind) AS "count" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' THEN 'water' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%pizza%' THEN 'pizza' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%poster%' THEN 'posters' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%donuts%' THEN 'donuts' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%muffins%' THEN 'muffins' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%cookies%' THEN 'cookies' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%veggie tray%' THEN 'veggie tray' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' THEN 'chips' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%club shirts%' THEN 'club shirts' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%parking%' THEN 'parking' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%travel mug%' THEN 'travel mug' WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%alumni glass%' THEN 'alumni glass' END AS "item_kind" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "x".link_to_budget INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".amount < "b".spent AND "e".event_date >= '2019-08-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01') AS "kinds" WHERE item_kind IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' THEN "x".cost ELSE 0 END), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member), 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chip%' AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" WHERE "b2".link_to_event = "e".event_id) AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b3".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b3" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x3" ON "x3".link_to_budget = "b3".budget_id WHERE "x3".expense_description ILIKE '%chip%') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_id) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "r" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "r".link_to_major = "m".major_id GROUP BY "m".college HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_id) = (SELECT MAX(major_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".major_id) AS "major_count" FROM "member" AS "r2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "r2".link_to_major = "m2".major_id GROUP BY "m2".college) AS "counts_by_college") ORDER BY "m".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 AND "e".location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_budget FROM "expense" WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "p" ON "p".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM(NULLIF("b".spent, 0)), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "per_event" WHERE 1 = 1 LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event AS "event_id", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "x".item_count IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE "x".item_count END), 0) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "expense".expense_description LIKE 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 3 WHEN "expense".expense_description LIKE 'Water, chips, cookies' THEN 3 WHEN "expense".expense_description LIKE 'Water, cookies, chips' THEN 3 WHEN "expense".expense_description LIKE 'Water, Cookies' THEN 2 WHEN "expense".expense_description LIKE 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS "item_count" FROM "expense" WHERE "expense".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id) AS "x" ON TRUE GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) SELECT "et".event_name FROM "event_totals" AS "et" LEFT JOIN "purchase_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".event_id = "et".event_id WHERE "et".total_spending <= "et".total_budget ORDER BY COALESCE("pc".purchases, 0) DESC, "et".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "attended_by_type" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type), "ranked" AS (SELECT type, members, MAX(members) OVER () AS "max_members" FROM "attended_by_type") SELECT type, members FROM "ranked" WHERE members = max_members LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "e".expense_description, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND "e".expense_date >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING("ev".event_date, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND "e".expense_date < TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING("ev".event_date, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 month', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY "b".category, "e".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b" WHERE "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) FROM "attendance" AS "a" WHERE "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "purchase_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "item_rows" AS (SELECT expense_id, link_to_member, cost, split_part(expense_description, ', ', 1) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' UNION ALL SELECT expense_id, link_to_member, cost, split_part(expense_description, ', ', 2) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' AND expense_description ILIKE 'Water, %'), "item_counts" AS (SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT item_name) AS "kind_count" FROM "item_rows" GROUP BY link_to_member), "spending" AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY link_to_member), "ranked" AS (SELECT "i".link_to_member, "i".kind_count, "s".total_spending, MAX("i".kind_count) OVER () AS "max_kind_count" FROM "item_counts" AS "i" INNER JOIN "spending" AS "s" ON "s".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member) SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", "r".kind_count, "r".total_spending FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "r".link_to_member WHERE "r".kind_count = "r".max_kind_count LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) AS "different_majors" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

WITH "eye_counts" AS (SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour) SELECT eye_colour, hero_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hero_count DESC) AS "rank" FROM "eye_counts" ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT publisher_name, superhero_count, superhero_count - MIN(superhero_count) OVER () AS "difference_from_lower_count" FROM (SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "dc".superhero_count > "marvel".superhero_count THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN "marvel".superhero_count > "dc".superhero_count THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS("dc".superhero_count - "marvel".superhero_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc" CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("character_roster".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "s".height_cm FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pm" ON "pm".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hpm" ON "hpm".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hpd".power_id FROM "superhero" AS "sd" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pd" ON "pd".id = "sd".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hpd" ON "hpd".hero_id = "sd".id WHERE "pd".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_power" ON "dc_power".power_id = "hpm".power_id WHERE "pm".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "dc_power".power_id IS NULL) AS "character_roster" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s"."alignment_id" = "a"."id" WHERE "a"."alignment" NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id AND "s".hair_colour_id = (SELECT "c".id FROM "colour" AS "c" WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id) >= 10 WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "hulk_strength".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_strength" ON "hulk_strength".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "strength_attr" ON "strength_attr".id = "hulk_strength".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "strength_attr".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_pub" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dc_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dc_eye" ON "dc".eye_colour_id = "dc_eye".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "h".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "h".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_eyes" ON "marvel_eyes".colour = "dc_eye".colour WHERE "dc_pub".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "s".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "p".publisher_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("p".publisher_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501
