WITH "latest_sample" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_scl70" AS (SELECT id, "sc170" AS "result", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "sc170" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "ls".id FROM "latest_sample" AS "ls" INNER JOIN "latest_scl70" AS "s" ON "s".id = "ls".id AND "s".rn = 1 WHERE "ls".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".result IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ssa".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "ssa" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "up" ON "up".id = "ssa".id WHERE "ssa".ssa IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM("ssa".ssa)) NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "up"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("up"."U-PRO") <> '' AND BTRIM("up"."U-PRO") NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l"."rnp" AS INTEGER)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lc" ON "lc".id = "l".id WHERE "lc".cre < 1.5 AND "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".rnp_value = (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE ("p".sex IS NULL OR BTRIM("p".sex) = '') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('', '-') AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "p".id IN (SELECT "h".id FROM "laboratory" AS "h" WHERE "h".hgb < 10) GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX("x".rnp::INTEGER) FROM "patient" AS "q" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "x" ON "x".id = "q".id WHERE "q".admission IN ('', '-') AND "x".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "x".rnp <> 'negative' AND "q".id IN (SELECT "h".id FROM "laboratory" AS "h" WHERE "h".hgb < 10)) LIMIT 501

WITH "first_lab" AS (SELECT id, got, rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date ASC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "first_lab" WHERE rn = 1 AND got < 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC > 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" <> '-' AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l2"."U-PRO" <> '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::BIGINT > 4 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) AS "g" ON "g".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT "r".id FROM "laboratory" AS "r" WHERE "r".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "r".rnp <> 'negative' AND "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "r".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 GROUP BY "r".id) AS "rp" ON "rp".id = "p".id ORDER BY "g".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "l".date), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "l".date)) < (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "p".birthday), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "p".birthday)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "positive" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 4), "status" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".care_setting, CASE WHEN "pos".id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "positive" AS "pos" ON "pos".id = "e".id) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "status" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL AND ("l".id, "l".date) IN (SELECT id, MAX(date) FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AND "l".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "sle_patients" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%'), "patient_max" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) AS "max_dna" FROM "sle_patients" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".dna IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(max_dna) AS "value" FROM "patient_max") SELECT "pm".id, "pm".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM "patient_max" AS "pm" INNER JOIN "highest" AS "h" ON "pm".max_dna = "h".value INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "pm".id AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = "h".value LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l"), "counts" AS (SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rn = 1 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 GROUP BY "p".sex) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F'), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(n) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M'), 0) AS "female_minus_male" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_lab" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F') SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "latest_lab" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '>=1000', '>=300', '+2(100)') GROUP BY id) AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND admission IN ('+', '+(') AND birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY birthday ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5), "group_ages" AS (SELECT "p".admission, "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) SELECT admission AS "care_setting", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(completed_age), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "group_ages" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%suspect%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp = '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "sm_lab" ON "sm_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "sm_lab".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rbc IS NOT NULL AND ("l".rbc <= 3.5 OR "l".rbc >= 6.0) AND "p".id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 'FM999999990.0')::NUMERIC AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC >= 64) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 15 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecules_with_single_bond" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) AS "molecule_bond_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS "bond_type", CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR010' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_atom_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_bond_groups" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COUNT("b".bond_id) > 0 AND BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') THEN 'every bond is single' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule_bond_groups" GROUP BY bond_group ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'every bond is single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a1".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_atom_count", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '+' AND "a2".element <> 'na'), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element <> 'na' AND ("a".atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected") OR "a".atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM "connected")) GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "ax" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "mx" ON "mx".molecule_id = "ax".molecule_id WHERE "mx".label = '+' AND "ax".element <> 'na' AND ("ax".atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected") OR "ax".atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM "connected")) GROUP BY "ax".element) AS "q") ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c1" ON "c1".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c1".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c2" ON "c2".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c2".atom_id AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "other".atom_id) AS "count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "chlorine".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other" ON "other".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element NOT IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "n" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "n".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "n".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "n".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id AND "n".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#'), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' AND "m".label IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" GROUP BY "a2".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_counts" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, COUNT("a".atom_id) AS "atom_count", COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "bc".carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, "mc".atom_count DESC, "mc".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "mc".molecule_id, "mc".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "mc".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "mc".carbon_atom_count, "mc".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "molecule_counts" AS "mc" LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "mc".molecule_id WHERE "mc".carbon_atom_count > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a1".molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element = 'y' LIMIT 1) AND ("a1".element = 'h' OR "a2".element = 'h') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(*) AS "count_of_bonds" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "bond".bond_type AS "bond_kind_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "bond".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("atom1".element, "atom2".element), GREATEST("atom1".element, "atom2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "molecule".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" INNER JOIN "bond" ON "bond".molecule_id = "molecule".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" ON "connected".bond_id = "bond".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "atom1" ON "atom1".atom_id = "connected".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "atom2" ON "atom2".atom_id = "connected".atom_id2 WHERE "molecule".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "bond".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "bond".bond_type, "molecule".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "bond".bond_id) DESC, "bond".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT "c".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) UNION ALL SELECT "c".atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id2 HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#'))) AS "single_only" ON "single_only".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
